page.overview:
Who is Duncan?

was one of the members of a team that had won the Hour of Honor three weeks in a row before Mighty Nein's victory. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer

Duncan was a gnomish gentleman with a patchy beard with missing centerpiece on his chin.
